name: Faff
notes: WhatsApp-only personal assistant for non-work life admin in India (Bangalore, Mumbai; cross-city once onboarded): groceries, repairs, travel, gifting, appointments. Human plus AI operations. Founders Het Patel and Anirudh Mittal, ~$2.6M raised. India-centric service area, so US booking and calling tasks may be out of scope. Requested via the form (issue #309).
tagline: A WhatsApp assistant for life admin in India
